title.zh: 授权并批准将第3738号共和国法授予Melvic公司的特许权转让给宿务市Jose S. Mercado的法案
title.en: An Act Authorizing and Approving the Transfer of the Franchise Granted to Melvic and Company, Incorporated by Republic Act Numbered Thirty-Seven Hundred Thirty-Eight in Favor of Jose S. Mercado of Cebu City
title.orig: An Act Authorizing and Approving the Transfer of the Franchise Granted to Melvic and Company, Incorporated by Republic Act Numbered Thirty-Seven Hundred Thirty-Eight in Favor of Jose S. Mercado of Cebu City

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4616_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the provisions of Republic Act Numbered Thirty-seven hundred thirty-eight, entitled "An Act to grant the Melvic and Company, Incorporated, a franchise for an electric light, heat and power system in the City of Toledo and the Municipalities of Aloguinsan and Pinamungajan, Province of Cebu," the transfer of the franchise granted to Melvic and Company, Incorporated by the said Act, in favor of Jose S. Mercado of Cebu City, is hereby authorized and approved.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
